content.title: How to watch South Florida vs. Louisville men’s basketball: First Round TV channel and streaming options for March 19
content.text: The No. 6 Louisville Cardinals (23-10) and the No. 11 South Florida Bulls (25-8) square off on Thursday for a place in the second round of the NCAA Tournament. The opening-round matchup tips off at 1:30 p.m. ET.How to watch South Florida Bulls vs. Louisville Cardinals Venue: KeyBank Center Time: 1:30 p.m. ET TV: TNT Watching in person? Get tickets on StubHub. It has a +415 scoring differential overall and outscores opponents by 12.6 points per game. Louisville connects on 11.5 three-pointers per game (fifth-most in college basketball) while shooting 35.7% from deep (85th in college basketball). It is making 3.9 more threes per outing than its opponents, who drain 7.6 per game while shooting 32.7%. South Florida has a +403 scoring differential, topping opponents by 12.2 points per game. It is putting up 87.7 points per game, eighth in college basketball, and is giving up 75.5 per contest to rank 228th in college basketball. South Florida knocks down 9.6 three-pointers per game (45th in college basketball), 1.4 more than its opponents. It shoots 33.2% from deep (222nd in college basketball), and its opponents are shooting 33.9%.
